<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913877_theRebbe_326" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913877_theRebbe_326__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening heading for the maamar for the night before Rosh Hashanah 5743.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">The night of Erev Rosh Hashanah 5743*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions why the Torah commandment of shofar was nullified in the provinces due to a rabbinic decree, and why the verses of Shofaros are still recited even when the shofar is not blown.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"On Yom Tov of Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat, in the Temple they would blow [the shofar], but not in the provinces."</t>
    <t s="1">And it needs to be understood</t>
    <t s="2">[as the Tzemach Tzedek, the Admo"r, precisely notes</t>
    <t s="3">in his maamar beginning with the words "To understand the reason"],</t>
    <t s="4">Now, the blowing of the shofar is a positive Torah commandment, as it is written,</t>
    <t s="5">"A day of sounding [the shofar] it shall be for you,"</t>
    <t s="6">and how could they nullify</t>
    <t s="7">it because of a decree, lest one carry it four cubits in the public domain, etc.</t>
    <t s="8">And even more so, there is room for wonder,</t>
    <t s="9">for from the fact that in the Temple they would blow [the shofar] even on Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat, it is proven that the mitzvah of shofar blowing exists in actuality even on Yom Tov of Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat,</t>
    <t s="10">so why did they nullify it outside the Temple, and even in the provinces, because of the decree lest one carry it?</t>
    <t s="11">And it also needs to be understood</t>
    <t s="12">that the verses of Shofaros are recited even on Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat,</t>
    <t s="13">for although the recitation of the verses is connected and comes as a continuation of the shofar blowing,</t>
    <t s="14">and on Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat they do not blow [the shofar] in the provinces,</t>
    <t s="15">nevertheless, the recitation of the verses is also [done] on Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that all mitzvos, including shofar, are performed below to effect a corresponding arousal from above, as the supernal mitzvos are actualized through human action.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And he explains this</t>
    <t s="1">(in the aforementioned maamar)</t>
    <t s="2">based on what is known, that all our mitzvos are</t>
    <t s="3">(in order)</t>
    <t s="4">that through an arousal from below, there is an arousal from above.</t>
    <t s="5">That is,</t>
    <t s="6">that what Israel fulfills the mitzvos is in order to effect through them the supernal mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="7">For behold, all the supernal mitzvos are made through the fact that the person below fulfills the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="8">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="9">"And you shall do them,"</t>
    <t s="10">"you" is written,</t>
    <t s="11">"I consider it as if you made Me,"</t>
    <t s="12">"The 248 positive commandments are the 248 limbs of the King,"</t>
    <t s="13">in the aspect of Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="14">and the drawing down of light into the vessels of Zeir Anpin, as well as the enlargement of the vessels, is specifically through the fulfillment of the mitzvos by the lower person,</t>
    <t s="15">as it is written, "which a person shall do and live by them,"</t>
    <t s="16">for the supernal mitzvos are specifically through "which a person shall do,"</t>
    <t s="17">soul in body.</t>
    <t s="18">For so it is with the mitzvah of shofar blowing,</t>
    <t s="19">that through Israel blowing the shofar,</t>
    <t s="20">there is thereby effected a supernal shofar blowing.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
